source.post_text: What movies blew you away with their excellent cinematography?

replies.text: Blade Runner 2049. Every frame looks like a painting.
replies.author: @Litlenstrik

replies.text:
May sound dumb but Devil Wears Prada 2 hahah

replies.text: 1917. The long-take battlefield framing and muted color palette pulled you straight into the chaos in a way few war films manage.
